summary: A blocking CUPS restart dialog now verifies fresh IPP connections before the app resumes after global configuration changes.
changelog: Shows a non-dismissible Restarting CUPS dialog after retention or global server settings are saved, including during onboarding.
Blocks every PyCUPS window and application action until fresh IPP connections answer consistently.
Pauses automatic job-history refresh and suppresses transient connection errors while the scheduler is restarting.
Replaces the pre-restart PyCUPS connection with the newly verified connection before reloading jobs and settings.
Keeps the application blocked and automatically starts another probe if CUPS remains unavailable; Try again and Close PyCUPS remain available.
Adds readiness, timeout, shutdown-cancellation, and application-wide blocking regression coverage.
